china-1931-2:p0387_1.rationale: Cuttings made in the Hai Ho to shorten the river are channel improvement works, with dates, cutting lengths and river length eliminated.

china-1931-2:p0388_1.rationale: Vessels arriving at the Tientsin Bund by year with maximum draught are port traffic measures.

china-1931-2:p0388_2.rationale: Pilotage charges by route and vessel type at Tientsin Harbour are transport charges at a port.

china-1931-2:p0390_1.rationale: Water areas of the Great and Small Harbours at Tsingtao describe port facilities.
review_questions: Is a vocabulary tag for harbour dimensions or facilities needed?

china-1931-2:p0390_2.rationale: Lengths of moles and quay lines at Tsingtao harbour describe berthing facilities of a port.

china-1931-2:p0390_3.rationale: Depth of water alongside the Tsingtao moles describes port capacity for vessels.

china-1931-2:p0395_1.rationale: Dry dock dimensions (length, breadth, sill depth) at Shanghai are harbour facilities.
review_questions: Should a tag for dry docks or ship repair facilities be added? Shipbuilding covers construction and repair but the table gives only dock dimensions.

china-1931-2:p0395_2.rationale: Pilotage tariff per foot and tonnage charges for steamers on Shanghai approach routes are port charges.

china-1931-2:p0395_3.rationale: Wharfage dues per picul on goods such as silk, tea and cocoons are port handling charges; the goods are incidental.

china-1931-2:p0399_1.rationale: Pilotage charges for sailing vessels at Canton and Whampoa, in cents per registered ton by route.
